# pve_cluster (Data Source)

Cluster inventory: identity, quorum status, resource list, and recent tasks.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pve_cluster" "example" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `type` (String) Resource type. One of: `vm`, `storage`, `node`, `sdn`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier: .
- `info` (String) Raw JSON payload returned by /cluster (the API schema does not describe its shape).
- `members` (Attributes List) Returned by /cluster/status. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--members))
- `resources` (Attributes List) Returned by /cluster/resources. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--resources))
- `tasks` (Attributes List) Returned by /cluster/tasks. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tasks))

<a id="nestedatt--members"></a>
### Nested Schema for `members`

Read-Only:

- `api_id` (String)
- `ip` (String) [node] IP of the resolved nodename.
- `level` (String) [node] Proxmox VE Subscription level, indicates if eligible for enterprise support as well as access to the stable Proxmox VE Enterprise Repository.
- `local` (Boolean) [node] Indicates if this is the responding node.
- `name` (String)
- `nodeid` (Number) [node] ID of the node from the corosync configuration.
- `nodes` (Number) [cluster] Nodes count, including offline nodes.
- `online` (Boolean) [node] Indicates if the node is online or offline.
- `quorate` (Boolean) [cluster] Indicates if there is a majority of nodes online to make decisions
- `type` (String) Indicates the type, either cluster or node. The type defines the object properties e.g. quorate available for type cluster.
- `version` (Number) [cluster] Current version of the corosync configuration file.


<a id="nestedatt--resources"></a>
### Nested Schema for `resources`

Read-Only:

- `api_id` (String) Resource id.
- `cgroup_mode` (Number) The cgroup mode the node operates under (for type 'node').
- `content` (String) Allowed storage content types (for type 'storage').
- `cpu` (Number) CPU utilization (for types 'node', 'qemu' and 'lxc').
- `disk` (Number) Used disk space in bytes (for type 'storage'), used root image space for VMs (for types 'qemu' and 'lxc').
- `diskread` (Number) The number of bytes the guest read from its block devices since the guest was started. This info is not available for all storage types. (for types 'qemu' and 'lxc')
- `diskwrite` (Number) The number of bytes the guest wrote to its block devices since the guest was started. This info is not available for all storage types. (for types 'qemu' and 'lxc')
- `hastate` (String) HA service status (for HA managed VMs).
- `host_arch` (String) The node's CPU architecture. (for type 'node').
- `level` (String) Support level (for type 'node').
- `lock` (String) The guest's current config lock (for types 'qemu' and 'lxc')
- `maxcpu` (Number) Number of available CPUs (for types 'node', 'qemu' and 'lxc').
- `maxdisk` (Number) Storage size in bytes (for type 'storage'), root image size for VMs (for types 'qemu' and 'lxc').
- `maxmem` (Number) Number of available memory in bytes (for types 'node', 'qemu' and 'lxc').
- `mem` (Number) Used memory in bytes (for types 'node', 'qemu' and 'lxc').
- `memhost` (Number) Used memory in bytes from the point of view of the host (for types 'qemu').
- `name` (String) Name of the resource.
- `netin` (Number) The amount of traffic in bytes that was sent to the guest over the network since it was started. (for types 'qemu' and 'lxc')
- `netout` (Number) The amount of traffic in bytes that was sent from the guest over the network since it was started. (for types 'qemu' and 'lxc')
- `network` (String) The name of a Network entity (for type 'network').
- `network_type` (String) The type of network resource (for type 'network').
- `node` (String) The cluster node name (for types 'node', 'storage', 'qemu', and 'lxc').
- `plugintype` (String) More specific type, if available.
- `pool` (String) The pool name (for types 'pool', 'qemu' and 'lxc').
- `protocol` (String) The protocol of a fabric (for type 'network', network-type 'fabric').
- `sdn` (String) The name of an SDN entity (for type 'sdn')
- `shared` (Boolean) Determines whether the storage is shared
- `status` (String) Resource type dependent status.
- `storage` (String) The storage identifier (for type 'storage').
- `tags` (String) The guest's tags (for types 'qemu' and 'lxc')
- `template` (Boolean) Determines if the guest is a template. (for types 'qemu' and 'lxc')
- `type` (String) Resource type.
- `uptime` (Number) Uptime of node or virtual guest in seconds (for types 'node', 'qemu' and 'lxc').
- `vmid` (Number) The numerical vmid (for types 'qemu' and 'lxc').
- `zone_type` (String) The type of an SDN zone (for type 'sdn').
